cs.t: Find yourself a clean set of Minimus-7 speakers (yes, from Radio Shack) and optionally upgrade the crossovers. They have a die cast enclosure and actually sound pretty great compared to the various plastic speakers I have used. You could certainly add a subwoofer to that setup but it's worth listening without one first.
cs.th: Ask HN: Recommend me a good set of 2.1 desktop speakers?
